Hannah Fischer, Senior Tech Lead at AdvertiseNow Media, is a driven adtech professional whose work has significantly shaped our cloud infrastructure and team dynamics.  

She spearheaded AWS migration for ad campaign platforms, reducing costs by 22% through optimized resource allocation and Terraform automation. Her Terraform modules now standardize infrastructure across 12+ services, cutting deployment time by 40%. She also rearchitected our cloud cost model, identifying $1.2M in annual overspending and implementing dynamic scaling policies that cut peak usage by 35%.  

Her Agile frameworks streamlined cross-functional campaigns, aligning engineering, data science, and marketing teams to launch features 30% faster. She designed scalable architectures for real-time ad analytics, handling 50M+ data points daily while maintaining sub-100ms latency. Stakeholders consistently praise her clarity in translating technical constraints into business priorities.  

Hannah’s leadership blends technical rigor with empathy, fostering a culture where innovation and accountability thrive. She’s a strategic thinker and hands-on executor—someone who will elevate any team.
